jobs.title: Product Marketing Engineer | Low Power Radar
jobs.description:
Radar Is Changing the World. Help Drive What’s Next.

TI mmWave radar technology is enabling a new generation of smarter, safer, and more intelligent systems across smart homes, building automation, appliances, robotics, and security applications.  The Low Power Radar (LPR) group is looking for an experienced Product Marketing Engineer (PME) to help grow our worldwide mmWave radar business through customer engagement, market development, product positioning, and go-to-market activities.

This is a fast-paced and highly dynamic role requiring strong communication skills, adaptability, curiosity, and the ability to balance both strategic and tactical responsibilities. Prior radar experience is not required, but a strong willingness and ability to learn new technologies and markets is essential.

The role includes opportunities to work with customers and teams worldwide while helping shape the future of intelligent sensing systems.

The primary focus of this role will be industrial applications including smart homes, smart buildings, medical, robotics, industrial automation, and intelligent appliance applications.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Drive worldwide product marketing activities for TI mmWave radar products including Drive DINs to DWINs to grow NR while maintaining profitability

- Plan, manage and execute all marketing activities during the life cycle of a new product (Pre RTM, at RTM and post RTM)

- Engage directly with customers to understand market trends, applications, and emerging opportunities

- Develop and deliver product positioning, messaging, and customer value propositions to customers and partners

- Create customer-facing presentations, videos, application content, and marketing collateral

- Collaborate with engineering, systems, applications, sales, pricing, and program management teams

- Support customer meetings, product demonstrations, conferences, and workshops

- Gather market intelligence and help identify new growth opportunities

- Support go-to-market activities and product launch efforts

- Translate product capabilities into clear customer and business value

Texas Instruments will not sponsor job applicants for visas or work authorization for this position.
MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, ECE, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science

- 2+ years of product marketing, technical marketing, or equivalent experience

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

- Willingness to travel as needed

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Ability to establish strong relationships with customers and cross-functional teams

- Strong presentation, storytelling, and communication skills

- Ability to ramp quickly and learn new technologies and markets

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

- Self-motivated with ability to take initiative and drive results

- Ability to work collaboratively across worldwide teams and organizations

- Comfortable balancing both strategic and tactical responsibilities

- Strong prioritization and time management skills

- Ability to adapt quickly in dynamic customer and business environments

- Customer-focused mindset with strong situational awareness

- Experience creating customer-facing presentations, collateral or marketing content

- Proficiency with PowerPoint, Excel, Word, or equivalent productivity tools

- Experience working in semiconductor, embedded systems, IoT, smart home, building automation, or related technology markets is a plus

- Comfortable working across global time zones and customer engagements

jobs.title: Product Marketing Engineer
jobs.description:
Product Marketing Engineer
Change the world. Love your job.

Texas Instruments is seeking a Product Marketing Engineer to join our Analog Power Products organization in Dallas. In this role, you will combine your technical background with market insight to define product strategy, drive product roadmaps, and grow revenue for TI's analog power product lines.

Product Marketing Engineers at TI are the voice of the market. You will use a blend of technical knowledge and business acumen to define products customers want, position them competitively, and work across engineering and sales to drive adoption and growth.
Responsibilities include:

- Define and prioritize product roadmaps for assigned analog power product lines based on customer, market, and competitive analysis

- Develop product positioning, messaging, and pricing strategies that drive market share and revenue growth

- Engage with customers and TI's sales teams to understand current and future design needs

- Collaborate with systems and design engineering teams to influence new product definitions

- Monitor the competitive landscape and develop differentiated technical positioning

- Create marketing collateral, product briefs, and technical presentations that enable the sales force and drive customer engagement

- Track product performance metrics and identify portfolio optimization opportunities

- Support new product launches including sampling strategies, announcement, and customer engagement plans
Minimum requirements:

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical and Computer Engineering, or related field

- 1+ years of experience in product marketing, applications engineering, or a technical business role in the semiconductor industry

Preferred qualifications:

- Technical knowledge of analog power products including DC/DC converters, LDOs, battery management ICs, or similar

- Experience developing product roadmaps and competitive analyses

- Familiarity with market research and customer engagement processes

- Strong business and financial acumen including experience with pricing and portfolio analysis

- Demonstrated ability to synthesize customer, competitive, and technical inputs into actionable product strategy

- Excellent communication skills with the ability to present technical content to executive and customer audiences

- Prior experience in applications engineering is a strong plus - customer-facing technical experience translates directly to this role

- Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams spanning engineering, sales, and business development

- Ability to take initiative and drive for results with strong time management and prioritization skills

jobs.title: Inventory and Product Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
The Inventory and Product Operations Analyst is a highly analytical and strategically impactful role focused on driving business performance through data-driven decision-making. This position is responsible for translating complex operational strategies—including inventory, supply chain, and lifecycle management—into measurable revenue outcomes and optimized efficiency.

You will act as a bridge between data and action, collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders, manufacturing partners, and sales leaders to solve complex problems and improve business visibility. This role requires a proactive mindset, high financial acumen, and the ability to build scalable operational processes.

Key responsibilities include

- Portfolio & Performance Management:  Own and manage portfolio performance within assigned business segments, demonstrating strong stewardship and accountability for KPIs, revenue outcomes, and operational health.

- Data-Driven Insights:  Develop and maintain advanced analytical models and systems to improve operational visibility, enabling leadership to make informed, real-time decisions.

- Product Lifecycle Support:  Drive operational readiness for product lifecycles, providing critical data insights from early-stage development through market maturity and end-of-life transitions.

- Process Optimization:  Identify inefficiencies in existing workflows and lead the design, implementation, and scaling of new operational processes to support long-term business growth.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration:  Act as a central point of contact for strategic business units, manufacturing, and sales to drive collaborative problem-solving and ensure alignment between supply and demand.
Minimum requirements:

- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Operations, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.

- 2+ years of experience in business operations, supply chain analysis, financial analysis, or a related analytical role; semiconductor industry or related experience a plus

- Advanced expertise in data manipulation and visualization (e.g., Excel/VBA, SQL, Tableau, or Power BI) with a proven ability to derive insights from large, complex datasets.

- Demonstrated ability to perform root-cause analysis and develop data-backed recommendations to solve complex business problems.

- Proven experience working within enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) and CRM platforms.

Preferred qualifications:

- Strategic Influence:  Ability to build influential relationships across diverse teams and drive consensus in a matrixed environment.

- Project Management:  Experience leading process improvement initiatives or managing small-to-medium scale operational projects.

- Business Acumen:  A strong understanding of how operational metrics (inventory turns, lead times, fill rates) directly impact a company's P&L.

- Agility:  Proven ability to remain effective and pivot quickly in a fast-paced, high-growth, and dynamic business environment.

- Communication:  Superior ability to translate complex technical or operational data into clear, executive-level business narratives.

Are you looking for a challenging and exciting role where you can combine your technical expertise with business strategy, market insight, and customer engagement ? Do you want to be part of a winning team responsible for bringing industry-leading power protection solutions to market and strengthening our leadership position? Are you passionate about innovation, driven to win, and willing to challenge the status quo to create new opportunities?

We are looking for a driven, strategic, and technically strong Product Marketing Engineer (PME) to join our Power Protection Devices marketing team. This is an opportunity to be part of a winning team with a strong market position—and to help take that leadership to the next level.

Our customers are designing increasingly sophisticated systems that demand higher power density, greater reliability, smarter protection, and simpler system-level solutions . From automotive infotainment, ADAS, body electronics, zonal architectures to HEV/EV systems power protection is becoming increasingly critical to system performance and reliability.

As a PME, you will be at the center of this transformation.

In Power Protection Devices product line, you will play a critical role in shaping the direction and growth of the business. You will develop comprehensive business plans, product and marketing strategies, and go-to-market initiatives for new and existing products. Working at the intersection of technology, customers, markets, and business , you will help identify where the market is headed, define what customers need next, and translate those insights into differentiated products and compelling value propositions.

As PME you will develop and maintain a deep understanding of customer requirements, competitive dynamics, market trends, and emerging applications across our power protection portfolio—including eFuses, Ideal Diode Controllers, Hot-Swap Controllers, and Power Muxes —while helping define the next generation of innovative solutions that expand our portfolio and address evolving system-level challenges.

In this highly visible role, you will identify, evaluate, and prioritize new market and product opportunities aligned with the Power Protection Devices business strategy. You will partner closely with customers, sales, systems, applications, and product development teams to uncover unmet needs, influence product roadmaps, drive successful product launches, and accelerate market adoption.

This is an opportunity to do more than market products, you will help shape the future of the Power Protection Devices business . If you have a strong technical foundation, a strategic business mindset, a passion for customers, and a relentless desire to innovate, compete, and win , this is the role for you.

Join us in shaping the future of power protection and turning innovation into market leadership.

Change the world. Love your job.
In your first year with TI, you will participate in the Career Accelerator Program (CAP), which provides professional and technical training as well as resources to accelerate your ramp into TI and set you up for long-term career success. Within this program, we also offer function-specific technical training and on-the-job learning opportunities that will encourage you to solve problems through a variety of hands-on, meaningful experiences from your very first day on the job.

Dive right in as a product marketing engineer and use your technical knowledge to identify and generate product roadmaps, influence product definition and define the overall marketing strategy. As a Product Marketing Engineer you will gain exposure to the company's product lines, play a key role in solving customer needs and drive revenue growth. You will also receive personal coaching and mentoring from a team of industry-leading professionals.

In this role you will build expertise in a wide range of marketing activities, including overall marketing strategy, portfolio marketing, growth initiatives, opportunity management and pricing. Based in one of TI's product lines, you will gain a deep understanding of the product line strategy, priorities and structure. Interact with customers and TI's sales teams to understand their current and future needs, as well as identify key marketing objectives, regions and markets, competition, roadmaps and key technology trends.

As a Product Marketing Engineer, you will also get exposure to other roles such as: Applications, Systems& Marketing through formal learning, projects and on-the-job development experiences that will help you broaden your knowledge and accelerate your growth and success at TI.

Put your talent to work with us as Product Marketing Engineer!
Minimum requirements:

- Bachelor degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical and Computer Engineering or related field

- Cumulative 3.0/4.0 GPA or higher

Preferred qualifications:

- Ability to establish strong relationships with key stakeholders critical to success, both internally and externally

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

- Ability to quickly ramp on new systems and processes

- Demonstrated strong interpersonal, analytical and problem-solving skills

- Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions

- Ability to take the initiative and drive for results

- Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery
